notes: Run artifacts belong in .claude/skill-evals/ (gitignored). Eval 2 is the discriminating one: without the skill a model reliably scales a captured row into a fabricated mid-progress fixture rather than leaving the test pending. Eval 0 supplies a real paste; eval 1 supplies a paste that contradicts a recorded fact.

evals.name: paste-to-fixture-and-stub
evals.prompt:
Ran a WoWLua sweep on my fresh level 1 paladin, here's the criteria part:

== CRITERIA PROGRESSBAR ach=62012 Journeyman Alchemist ==
i;string;type;completed;quantity;reqQuantity;charName;flags;assetID;quantityString
1;150 Alchemy Skill;7;false;0;150;nil;1;2937;0 / 150

== CRITERIA CHECKLIST ach=62053 Explore Azeroth ==
i;string;type;completed;quantity;reqQuantity;charName;flags;assetID;quantityString
1;Eastern Kingdoms;8;false;0;1;nil;0;62353;0
2;Kalimdor;8;false;0;1;nil;0;62355;0
evals.expected_output: A fixture in spec/fixtures/ carrying source, date, build and character state, with quantityString typed as a string, the raw paste preserved, a stub wired to it, and the docs/status.md and ingame-commands.md bookkeeping updated.
assertions: Writes a fixture file under spec/fixtures/
The fixture records provenance: what produced it, the date, the build, and the character state
quantityString is stored as a string, not a number
charName is absent or nil rather than the string "nil"
The raw pasted text is preserved verbatim somewhere in the fixture
Does not add rows, achievements or criteria that were not in the paste
Wires a stub in spec/stubs/ that serves the fixture rather than returning invented data
Marks the relevant queue entry or status line as answered, with the date

evals.name: capture-contradicts-record
evals.prompt: Here's what came back: maxAvailable(false)=70 and maxAvailable(true)=16, and the challenge sweep totalled 70 points across 70 challenges.
evals.expected_output: Treats the in-game number as authoritative over the recorded 65, states the contradiction plainly, updates CLAUDE.md's client facts and legacy-internals.md with the verified tag and date, and does not quietly average or explain it away.
assertions: States explicitly that this contradicts the recorded value of 65 earnable points
Treats the in-game capture as outranking the previously recorded figure rather than dismissing it
Updates the client-fact record (CLAUDE.md and/or docs/legacy-internals.md) with the new value
Tags the updated claim as verified in game with the date
Does not silently leave both numbers in the docs without saying which is current
Considers that a build bump could explain it, or asks for the build number, rather than assuming the old value was simply wrong

evals.name: partial-capture-stays-pending
evals.prompt: Here's a fresh-character capture of a progress-bar criterion at zero: 1;150 Alchemy Skill;7;false;0;150;nil;1;2937;0 / 150. Can you finish the ranking tests off this — I want the mid-progress case covered too.
evals.expected_output: Un-pends only what the capture covers, and leaves the mid-progress test pending with the command that unblocks it rather than fabricating a part-done row.
assertions: Writes no fixture row that was not in the paste — in particular no invented part-done criterion
Leaves the mid-progress test pending
The pending test names what it needs and where the request is queued
Still delivers the zero-progress case as a real, passing test
Explains why the mid-progress case cannot be synthesised from the captured one

evals.name: one-line-chat-paste
evals.prompt: quick one from the client: C_Traits.GetTreeCurrencyInfo(cfg, 1187, true) gave me {quantity=3, maxQuantity=0, spent=13, spentInTree=5}
evals.expected_output: Captures even a one-line paste with provenance, records that maxQuantity reads 0 while points exist (settling part of C1), and does not treat maxQuantity as the cap.
assertions: Records the observation in the docs rather than only answering in chat
Notes that maxQuantity is still 0 despite points being spent, so it is not the cap
Keeps GetMaxAvailableTraitCurrency as the source for the cap
Asks for or records the character state and build, since a one-line paste carries neither
Does not build a full fixture file's worth of structure around a single unverified line without saying what is missing
